summary: Choose an open subgroup V such that all unramified-off-S cocycles with values in a finite auxiliary module vanish on V; then Selmer cocycles with m-torsion values factor through Gal/V, and are determined by their values at representatives of Gal/V, subject to the evaluated relations.

steps.claim: Choose an open subgroup U ⊆ W (Gal(Ω/E) has a basis of open subgroups at 1).
steps.lean:
{w | R ≤ (Fintype.linearCombination Λ w).ker} := (is_nonarchimedean _ hW).rec fun U hU ↦ by
  choose V hV using is_nonarchimedean _ ((selmerZ1.finite_unramified_cocycles (.funModule (.of
    (.trivial ℤ _ (ZMod m))) U) hS).eventually_all.2 fun z h ↦ (h.1.1.1 {_} (by simp)).mem_nhds rfl)
  use (_ ⧸ V.1) × n, .ofFinite _, .map (·.out) id, .span Λ (image2 (relEval _ · (Pi.single
    ⟨QuotientGroup.mk ·, ·⟩ 1)) (cocycleRels ρ ∪ (.single · 1) '' inertiaAbove Sᶜ ∪ L) univ ∪ range
    (m • ·)), (subset_span <| .inr ⟨·, rfl⟩), fun _ _ _ hm hρ ↦ ?_
  simp [span_le, -relEval, -mem_union, ← comp_mem_obeying_iff, -nsmul_eq_mul, *]
  refine InvOn.bijOn ⟨?F, by simp [LeftInvOn, (↿·)]⟩ (fun _ H ↦ (?F H ▸ H.1 :))
    fun w ↦ (⟨·, .of_discrete w.curry⟩)
  exact fun c H ↦ funext₂ fun x i ↦ sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_forall_hom_eq_zero
    ((bijective_ofZMod_comp hm).2.forall.2 fun χ ↦ by simpa using! congr(ofZMod m ($(hV
    (QuotientGroup.eq.1 (out_eq' ⟦x⟧).symm) (fun g ↦ Quotient.lift (fun a ↦ χ ((_ - c a⁻¹) i))
    (by rintro _ _ ⟨u, rfl⟩; simp [Subgroup.smul_def, mem_selmerModule_iff.1 H, hρ _ (hU
    (inv_mem u.2))])) ⟨⟨continuous_pi (Quotient.ind ((H.2.comp (χ <| · i - _)).continuous.comp <|
    continuous_const_mul ·⁻¹)), by simp⟩, by simp_all [mem_selmerModule_iff.1 H]⟩) ⟦x⁻¹⟧))))

steps.claim: The continuous cocycles unramified off S with values in the finite module of ℤ/m-valued functions on the cosets of U are finitely many (selmerZ1.finite_unramified_cocycles); each is locally constant, so there is an open subgroup V on which all of them vanish.
steps.lean:
choose V hV using is_nonarchimedean _ ((selmerZ1.finite_unramified_cocycles (.funModule (.of
    (.trivial ℤ _ (ZMod m))) U) hS).eventually_all.2 fun z h ↦ (h.1.1.1 {_} (by simp)).mem_nhds rfl)

steps.claim: Take ι = (Gal(Ω/E)/V) × n (finite, V open), γ(x, i) = (a representative of x, i), and R the Λ-span of the vectors obtained by evaluating the cocycle relations of ρ, the inertia relations off S and the relations L on the indicator vectors of (x, i), together with m·Λ^ι; then m·v ∈ R for all v.
steps.lean:
use (_ ⧸ V.1) × n, .ofFinite _, .map (·.out) id, .span Λ (image2 (relEval _ · (Pi.single
    ⟨QuotientGroup.mk ·, ·⟩ 1)) (cocycleRels ρ ∪ (.single · 1) '' inertiaAbove Sᶜ ∪ L) univ ∪ range
    (m • ·)), (subset_span <| .inr ⟨·, rfl⟩), fun _ _ _ hm hρ ↦ ?_

steps.claim: Unfolding: w ∈ B^ι is killed by R exactly when w, read as a function on the cosets, obeys these relations and m·w = 0.

The evaluation map is a bijection with inverse w ↦ (g ↦ w(gV, ·)), which is locally constant (V open) and a Selmer cocycle; it suffices to show that every Selmer cocycle c is right-V-invariant: c(x) = c(out(xV)).
steps.lean:
refine InvOn.bijOn ⟨?F, by simp [LeftInvOn, (↿·)]⟩ (fun _ H ↦ (?F H ▸ H.1 :))
    fun w ↦ (⟨·, .of_discrete w.curry⟩)

steps.claim: For a Selmer cocycle c and x: c(x) − c(out(xV)) is tested against every homomorphism χ : B → ℤ/m (B is killed by m); g ↦ χ((c(·) − c(g⁻¹·))_i) defines a continuous cocycle with values in the functions on the cosets of U, unramified off S (c is, and W ⊇ U acts trivially), hence it vanishes on V (step 1.1); evaluating at x⁻¹ gives χ(c(x) − c(out(xV))) = 0.
steps.lean:
exact fun c H ↦ funext₂ fun x i ↦ sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_forall_hom_eq_zero
    ((bijective_ofZMod_comp hm).2.forall.2 fun χ ↦ by simpa using! congr(ofZMod m ($(hV
    (QuotientGroup.eq.1 (out_eq' ⟦x⟧).symm) (fun g ↦ Quotient.lift (fun a ↦ χ ((_ - c a⁻¹) i))
    (by rintro _ _ ⟨u, rfl⟩; simp [Subgroup.smul_def, mem_selmerModule_iff.1 H, hρ _ (hU
    (inv_mem u.2))])) ⟨⟨continuous_pi (Quotient.ind ((H.2.comp (χ <| · i - _)).continuous.comp <|
    continuous_const_mul ·⁻¹)), by simp⟩, by simp_all [mem_selmerModule_iff.1 H]⟩) ⟦x⁻¹⟧))))
